verdict.rationale: VLP's Intellectual Property practice page says its lawyers prepare and file patent applications. It also says they evaluate existing patent portfolios, review competitive technologies and IP, and analyze licensing, so this is a documented group page covering prosecution plus portfolio strategy. IP due diligence is a related service. The evidence rests on one short claimed-docs passage. Missing for 10: named patent practitioners or bios, detail on prosecution scope (e.g., USPTO/PCT/foreign filings, technology areas), explicit description of building defensible patent positions, independent corroboration.
